description.value: One of five campgrounds inside Whiteswan Lake Park, Cave Creek is reached by roughly 25 km of gravel forest service road shared with mine ore and oversized logging trucks; the payoff is two mountain lakes, Lussier Hot Springs, and trophy rainbow trout fishing deep in the Kootenay Rockies with zero cell service.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks website confirms Cave Creek Campground as a named frontcountry campground within Whiteswan Lake Park, with a dedicated Cave Creek campground map PDF linked on the park page. The website's frontcountry camping reservation section and 'Book camping' function confirm reservations are accepted park-wide. No campground-specific amenity details (showers, potable water, hiker-biker sites, etc.) are provided for Cave Creek, so those fields remain null; the website also explicitly states there is no cell phone service at the park.
concerns: Access is via a 22km gravel Whiteswan Forest Service Road actively shared with mine ore trucks and oversized logging trucks — likely unsuitable for road/gravel cyclists without robust tires and careful timing.
Website explicitly states there is no public phone or cell phone service at Whiteswan Park.
No address or phone number present in OSM record.
Nearest community (Canal Flats) is 22km away; no food or services are available within the park.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Cave Creek Campground is a legitimate, named BC Parks frontcountry campground in a spectacular mountain setting; it is a valid backcountry destination for touring cyclists willing to tackle the gravel access road.

wow_evidence: Lussier Hot Springs...deep in the Kootenay Rockies
